modules.name: Object (OBJ)
modules.description: Rainforest: a resonant object (barrel, drum, cable, plate...) driven by transducers, heard in the air and through a contact pickup.

modules.name: Critter (CRT)
modules.description: Rainforest: four bird, insect and frog call generators that can learn an object's resonances.

modules.name: Seek (SEK)
modules.description: Rainforest: probes an object, finds its strongest resonances and teases them with a wandering tone.

modules.name: Wander (WND)
modules.description: Rainforest: places 8 objects and their loudspeakers in a room and walks a listener through it, stereo or quad.

modules.name: Pulser (PLS)
modules.description: Pulsers: rhythm from phase-shifted feedback. A resonant loop builds, fires, is quenched and builds again.

modules.name: Shift (SHF)
modules.description: Pulsers: variable phase-shift amplifier, fixed 0/90/180/270 degree shift plus an all-pass chain, for feedback loops.

modules.name: Tuned (TND)
modules.description: Pulsers: tuned and saturating band-pass amplifier that rings and limits itself in feedback.

modules.name: Sideband (SBM)
modules.description: Pulsers: modulator with variable sideband, from lower sideband through ring modulation to upper sideband.

modules.name: Loop (LOP)
modules.description: Pulsers: the giant oscillator. A 4x4 feedback matrix with sends, returns and keepers that hold each bus at the edge.

modules.name: Swell (SWL)
modules.description: Phonemes: percussion generator whose attacks stretch from a click to 8 seconds, fired by onsets or triggers.

modules.name: Phoneme (PHN)
modules.description: Phonemes: 16-band vocoder whose band levels are chopped into speech-like fragments.

modules.name: XGate (XGT)
modules.description: Phonemes: four channels cross-gated by each other's levels, moved around 4 or 6 outputs by a switcher.
